question.text: The number of integer values of $m$, for which the $x$ -coordinate of the point of intersection of the lines $3 x+4 y=9$ and $y=m x+1$ is also an integer, is

solution.text:
Given lines are, $3 x+4 y=9$
$$
y=m x+1
$$
Solving Eqs. (i) and (ii), we get
$$
x=\frac{5}{3+4 m}
$$
If $m=-1,$ then $x=-5$ and $m=-2,$ then $x=-1$ are the only 
possibilities.
